title: NightVisionToggle
description: 🌙 Smooth night-vision toggling for builders, miners, and moderators.
body:
# 🌙 NightVisionToggle

Toggle long-duration night vision on demand without menu bloat.

## ? What You Get
- Main command: `/nightvisiontoggle`
- Lightweight architecture with no hard dependencies
- OP/admin update checker in chat with direct version link

## ? Compatibility
- Java 17+
- Paper / Spigot / Purpur / Folia / Bukkit
- Minecraft 1.20+

## ? Support
- https://buymeacoffee.com/perusi
